snippet.title: Crooked Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cheat. Deceive. Win.

Think you can win without breaking a few rules? Think again. In Crooked, victory belongs to those willing to play dirty.

Will you play it safe, or will you risk it all for a dirty win?
